Complaints? Video submissions? Tips? Sponsorships? Collabs? Business inquires?

BE NICE:
The individuals presented in these videos may be suffering from the effects of alcohol, drug abuse, a mental health disorder or simply having a bad day. The videos should NOT be presumed to be representative of their general behavior. Everyone deserves to be treated with respect. 

RIGHT TO BE FORGOTTEN:
Midwest Safety practices the "Right to be Forgotten." If you were the suspect in a lower-level offense, you may email our board to reqeust removal. Email: mn.safety.alerts@gmail.com

Her and the male driver's two children, a one-year-old boy and a five-year-old girl, were treated at a local hospital and released to family members while the male was taken into custody. And even though I'm disgusted with the end result, and my opinion, no amount of prison time is going to help those children with what they will need for the rest of their lives.
